articles.title: FreeBSD GUS

This is achieved through a combination of read and synchronize operations, which block quiescent points and inhibit preemption during read operations. The scheme is part of the Epoch-based reclamation family and has been described in detail by its author, Paul McKenney, in his LWN Articles.
